title: Why 50 Surviving Otters Now Guard A Carbon Sink
hook: Fifty otters survived the fur trade, then ended up protecting a carbon sink.
closing: Saving one predator can protect an entire coastline and its carbon.
question: Would you welcome otters nearby?

segments.say: Only 50 California sea otters remained after the fur trade nearly wiped the species out.
That handful recovered to about 3,000 otters, though the species is still considered threatened.
The kelp forests those otters protect can store up to 8.7 million metric tons of CO2 a year.
